high_level_description: The image depicts a clothing store display featuring a black and white varsity-style jacket hanging on a hanger. The jacket is prominently displayed in the foreground, with its front facing the camera. It has a large white "F" on the left side of the chest, along with the text "Together connected" written in a cursive font near the right shoulder. Below the "F," there is an autograph and the phrase "Everything around me" written vertically. The jacket is paired with white pants that have black stripes on the cuffs. The pants are also hanging on a hanger, partially visible behind the jacket.
